# Arman

> Arman is a freelance video editor who edits videos for YouTube channels, social media creators, and brands.

## What Arman does

Arman edits raw footage into finished videos with clean pacing, sound design, and color. His work spans YouTube long-form, Shorts, Reels, TikTok, and brand campaigns. He is based in Bangladesh and works remotely with creators worldwide.

## Services

- Long-form YouTube editing (narrative structure, A/B-roll integration, motion graphic callouts, sound design, color grade)
- Short-form editing for YouTube Shorts, Reels, TikTok, and Facebook (hooks, pacing, captions, sound effects, speed ramping)
- Motion graphics and titles (kinetic typography, visual callouts)
- Color grading and finishing in DaVinci Resolve
- Podcast cutdowns and talking-head edits
- Brand videos, promos, and commercial edits

## Tools

- Adobe Premiere Pro — assembly, pacing, rough cuts, audio sync
- Adobe After Effects — kinetic titles, callouts, visual effects
- DaVinci Resolve — color grading, balancing, final master export
- CapCut Pro — mobile short-form pacing and dynamic captions
